phases.goal: Use the left arm to place the red block as the center base.
phases.name: place_red_base
phases.verify: Red block is stable at the base position.

phases.goal: Use the right arm to place the green block on the red block.
phases.name: place_green_middle
phases.verify: Green rests on red and the two-block stack is stable.

phases.goal: Use the left arm to place the blue block on the green block.
phases.name: place_blue_top
phases.verify: Blue rests on green and the three-block stack is stable.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Red block becomes the base first.
Green is placed on red without toppling red.
Blue is placed on green while preserving the red-green stack.

roles.manipulated_order: red base, green middle, blue top
roles.protected: partial stack remains stable while next block is manipulated
roles.target_stack: blue on green on red at the center

task_language: Move red block, green block, and blue block to the center using the left arm, the right arm, the left arm, and stack them with blue block on top.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 3:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 4:move_to(arm=left,gripper=open,orientation=keep); 5:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 6:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 7:move_to(arm=right,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 8:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 9:move_to(arm=right,gripper=open,orientation=keep); 10:move_to(arm=right,gripper=open,orientation=keep); 11:move_to(arm=right,gripper=open,orientation=keep); 12:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 13:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50); 14:move_to(arm=left,gripper=closed,orientation=keep); 15:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid reaching for blue before green is stable; verify red is the base, green is supported on red, and preserve both while placing blue.
